limitations: Local Node costs are not whole-game FPS. Browser frozen/live measurements and all regressions retained without overall gain attribution.

Synthetic branch fixtures and legal loadout fixtures are distinguished. Three immediate native baneling casts per source exercise overlap, not natural cooldown behavior.
